module: Auxiliary controller for bypass-channel shock absorbers (bypass shocks, off-road/Trophy truck type): a beam's damping changes depending on its travel along successive zones. At each physics step it measures the damper beam's displacement relative to its rest length and applies via `obj:setBoundedBeamDamp` the coefficients of the corresponding zone. It also plays a valve sound when the direction of movement reverses. Call order: `defaultOrder = 80`.
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `dampers` (header table with `name`, `beamName`: jbeam name of the beam) and `zones` (header table with `zoneDistance`, `beamDamp`, `beamDampFast`, `beamDampRebound`, `beamDampReboundFast`, `beamDampVelocitySplit`, `beamDampVelocitySplitRebound`; all 1 by default, the last takes `beamDampVelocitySplit`). The zones are sorted by increasing `zoneDistance`; each zone extends to the start of the next (the last to infinity). `zoneDistance` is the displacement in m relative to the rest length (positive = compression).

Keys read by initSounds: `emitValveSounds` (true), `valveSoundEventCompression` ("event:>Vehicle>Suspension>bypassShock_01>bypassShock_in"), `valveSoundEventRebound` ("...bypassShock_out"), `valveSoundMaxVolume` (0.5), `valveSoundMinVelocity` (0.05 m/s), `valveSoundMaxVelocity` (0.2 m/s).
The sound is emitted at the beam's node id1, in updateGFX, from the measurements of update.
The internal sound settings field is called `maxValocity` in the code (harmless typo).
If a named beam is not found, init crashes on `v.data.beams[nil]`: the beam name must exist.
`damperZones` is never emptied in init: a second init (without reloading the module) would duplicate the zones.

update.desc: Physics step: for each damper, computes displacement and velocity, detects the direction reversal (valve sound), finds the current zone and applies its damping coefficients if it changed.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: plays the valve sounds queued by update.

initSounds.desc: Reads the valve sound settings from the jbeam.

init.desc: Finds the damper beams by name and builds the sorted list of damping zones.
